items.title: Santo Pecora Interview, 1972-11-09
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] I never heard Lester Nelson... [INTERVIEWEE] Come on, have a little few drinks...

ctx.x: I think he's, I think, I'm, I'm, I'm, I'm not sure if he, because they used to go to school together. Oh, really? Oh, yeah, they live in the same neighborhood. Oh, that's why they almost play well, I like. Yeah. See?
I never heard Lester Nelson, but they tell me he was a good saxophone club. That's a guy that I never heard a record.
Come on, have a little few drinks, you gotta take a sip. A sip. A sip before we go.
